{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now filter for: new customers, paid_search channel
filtered = sales_clean[
    (sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (sales_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Count total and converted
total_in_group = len(filtered)
converted_in_group = filtered['converted'].sum()

# Compute fraction
fraction_converted = converted_in_group / total_in_group if total_in_group > 0 else 0

# Verify that no QA orders remain in the group
qa_in_filtered = (filtered['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"QA orders in filtered group (should be 0): {qa_in_filtered}")

fraction_converted"}
